column1: # Rugs whose corners automatic detection cannot find, and the corners to use instead.
# Format: code <tab> TL <tab> TR <tab> BR <tab> BL   (x,y pixel pairs in the source photo)
# WHY EACH ONE IS HERE. detect_corners takes the largest connected blob that differs
# from the border colour. VLR-207 was shot on speckled concrete with stacks of stock in
# the frame, so the blob it found was the whole photograph rather than the rug.
